sanskrit_verse:
कर्मापि द्विविधं प्रोक्तम् अशुभं शुभमेव च ।
अशुभं दासकर्मोक्तं शुभं कर्मकरे स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: karmāpi dvividhaṃ proktam aśubhaṃ śubham eva ca | aśubhaṃ dāsakarmoktaṃ śubhaṃ karmakare smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Action is declared twofold: that which is unwholesome and that which is wholesome. Unwholesome action pertains to servitude; wholesome action belongs to the doer.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious capacity, not coercive imposition.
Causation originates in individual agency, not external compulsion.
Responsibility aligns with the actor's level of awareness and freedom.
Restoration occurs through realignment with one’s true nature as sovereign doer.
Consciousness is the ultimate determinant of action’s quality.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act originates from constrained will THEN it is classified as 'dāsakarma' AND must be addressed via liberation protocols.
IF an act arises from free-conscious intention THEN it is classified as 'karmakara' AND subject to integrity-based completion processes.
All adjudication MUST assess the agent's capacity for choice at time of action.
No legal consequence shall degrade or bind further; all outcomes must restore autonomy.
Every judicial process MUST include verification of prior conditioning influencing the act.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility lies exclusively in determining whether the action originated from constrained or liberated consciousness. Authority flows from the recognition of svatantrya (self-sovereignty), and judgments must reflect restoration of that sovereignty rather than imposition of punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that action manifests according to the state of consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that unwholesome acts stem from ignorance-bound conditioning, while wholesome acts arise from awakened intent. Therefore, proportional responsibility is measured by the degree of conscious clarity present. Nyaya demands no infliction of pain but insists on realigning the actor with their inherent completeness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svādhyāya Process to reveal underlying conditionings causing unwholesome action.
Assign Karma Yoga Completion Ritual to purify residual impressions of servile behavior.
Reintegrate individual into community through Yajña-based service aligned with higher purpose.
Establish mentorship under enlightened guide until full restoration of self-authority is verified.
Conduct periodic consciousness audits to ensure continued alignment with svadharma.
final_declaration: This ruling proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
